page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note at the left margin beside the line "lofophus libro". Running head at the top, page number "62" at the head, catchword "ita" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: ipfa plenilunia redduntur pleniora, & per interlunia fiunt uacua. Quod autem hæc animalia plenilunijs pleniora fint, & ipfa filente Luna, uideantur uacua, nemo ambigere poteft, quoniam res ipfa per fe fatis loquitur: quomodo tamen id fiat, controuerfantur multi. Nonnulli enim id fieri exiftimant, quòd per plenilunij tempus, quod quidem noctu lucidius eft, hæc animalia fplendore Lunæ, ac luce illuminata liberius copiofiusq; pafcatur. His adde quòd tu fuos hoftes perfpectos fugere, & utilia ad uitamq; fuam neceffaria perfeq; tutius pofint: Vnde pleniora aucto alimento reddantur. Imo uero pleniora fiunt, quòd tunc noctes funt propter Lunæ pleniorem lucem tepidiores. Calorem enim efflagitant huiusmodi animalia: quoniam frigori patent, utpote quæ exanguia funt: Vnde fit ut æsta te ubiq; uigeant: aliis uero temporibus minimè:aut faltem Vere & Autumno. Quod autem plena Luna calefaciat, nihil mirari oportet, quoniam ipfa tum temporis alter Sol eft, fed minor, ueluti nobis oftedit phi-Cap.10.lofophus libro 4. de Generatione animalium. Quemadmodum (inquit) Sol per totum annum hyemen atque æftatem efficit:

page.notes: The word "tu" after "quòd" may carry a tilde over the u (tū); read as printed "tu". The line-end "no-/ctes" is a break without a printed hyphen, so it is written whole as "noctes". The catchword "ita" stands alone at the right below the last line. The running head and page number are as printed.
